title: A blind design brief is built from a template that cannot carry today's screen
why: Your gripe, Oct 26 22:58 CDT (cmsg_01DoF7thf3iq2Srr1UsfXgh25oZAnWn5W9c5JNRybsYuw9): every Duo mockup for mailaudit copied the current app; the orchestrator's one brief said "Duo layouts must keep that look", sent the designer to the web app first, asked to rearrange the three existing views, and held every variable but one.
note: What went wrong: the session ran no blind lane at all, and its one brief carried today's screens and a keep rule. d10 (designer lanes: blind, informed, directed; skill design-explore, merged Oct 26 22:10 CDT, after that session started) says a blind brief that names the current screen is a defect, but only in prose: the orchestrator still writes the brief by hand, may change the lane mix, and nothing reads the brief. Fix, needs no answer, on top of d10: (1) design-explore builds each blind brief from a fixed template: the user's job in their words, the device and its poses, the house rules and the brand palette only; (2) a check refuses a blind brief that names a current view, a screenshot or mockup path, the spec, or a keep or match rule, and refuses an explore run with no blind lane unless you asked for none; (3) design-review flags a set of mockups that all share today's structure. Red first on the Duo brief. Port: yes; the skills install everywhere. Placed ahead of c93, after c107 (triage, Oct 27): every design round in every repo rests on its briefs.
ask: Build thread dispatched by build advisor (7), Oct 27; brief briefs/c109-blind-brief-template.md on the roadmap branch.
